column3: ṣaṣṭyā ṣaṣṭyā yutaṁ dvābhyāṁ parvaṇāṁ rāśir ucyate ||
svar ākramete somārkau yadā sākaṁ savāsavau |
syāt tadādi yugaṁ māghas tapaḥ śuklo .yanaṁ hy udak ||
caturthaṁ daśamaṁ ca dvir yugmādyaṁ bahule .pyṛtau ||
vasus tvaṣṭā bhavo .jaś ca mitraḥ sarpāśvinau jalam |
tryaṁśo bhaśeṣo divasāṁśabhāgaś caturdaśaś cāpy anīya bhārdhe .dhike cāpi gate paro .ṁśo dvāv uttamaikaṁ |
pakṣāt pañcadaśāc cordhvaṁ tadbhuktam iti nirdiśet |
jau drā ghaḥ khe śve .hī ro ṣā cin mū ṣa ṇyaḥ sū mā dhā ṇaḥ re mṛ ghrāḥ svā .po .jaḥ kṛ ṣyo ha jye ṣṭhā ittṛkṣā liṅgaiḥ ||
bhādānaṁ syāt caturdaśyāṁ kāṣṭhānāṁ devinā kalāḥ ||
kalā daśa saviṁśā syāt dve muhūrtasya nāḍike |
dyutriṁśat tatkalānāṁ tu ṣaṭchatī tryadhikaṁ bhavet ||
nāḍike dve muhūrtas tu pañcāśatpalam āḍhakam |
āḍhakāt kumbhako droṇaḥ kuṭapair vardhate tribhiḥ ||
sasaptakaṁ bhayuk somaḥ sūryo dyūni trayodaśa |
navabhāni ca pañcāhnaḥ kāṣṭhāḥ pañcākṣarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
staryān māsān ṣaḍabhyastān vidyāc cāndramasān ṛtun ||
prakṣipet tatsamūhas tu vidyād ādānikīḥ kalāḥ ||
yad uttarasyāyanato gataṁ syāc cheṣaṁ tu yad dakṣiṇato tad ekaṣaṣṭyā dviguṇaṁ vibhaktaṁ sadvādaśaṁ syād |
yad ardhaṁ dinabhāgānāṁ sadā parvaṇi parvaṇi |
ṛtuśeṣaṁ tu tad vidyāt saṁkhyāya sahaparvaṇām ||
sarpāś ca pitaraś caiva bhagaś caivāryamāpi ca ||
savitā tvaṣṭātha vāyuś cendrāgnī mitra eva ca |
indro niṛrtir āpo vai viśvedevās tathaiva ca ||
viṣnur vasavo varuṇo .ja ekapāt tathaiva ca |
ahirbudhnyas tathā pūṣā aśvinau yama eva ca ||
viṣuvaṁ tadguṇaṁ dvābhyāṁ rūpahīnaṁ tu ṣaḍguṇam |
yal labdhaṁ tāni parvāṇi tathārdhaṁ sā tithir bhavet ||
ṣaṣṭhīṁ ca viṣuvān prokto dvādaśīṁ ca samaṁ bhavet ||
caturdaśīm upavasathas tathā bhaved yathodito dinam māghaśuklāhniko yuṅkte śraviṣṭhāyāṁ ca vārṣikīm ||
yathā śikhā mayūrāṇāṁ nāgānāṁ maṇayo yathā |
vedā hi yajñārthamabhipravṛttāḥ kālānupūrvā vihitāśca tasmādidaṁ kālavidhānaśāstraṁ yo jyotiṣaṁ veda sa veda |
